metrics.label: COMPOSITE RECOVERY
metrics.tip: Daily composite recovery score combining recovery/sleep-score sources. Weighted formula: WHOOP Recovery × 0.5 + Garmin Sleep Score × 0.3 + 8Sleep Score × 0.2. Body Battery is shown separately and is not used as the Garmin sleep score.

metrics.label: 7D AVG RECOVERY
metrics.tip: 7-day rolling average of composite recovery scores. Calculated as: WHOOP Recovery × 0.5 + Garmin Sleep Score × 0.3 + 8Sleep Score × 0.2, averaged over 7 days. Smooths daily fluctuations to show baseline trend.

metrics.label: TREND
metrics.tip: Direction of recovery trend over recent days. STABLE = minimal change, IMPROVING = consistent upward trend, DECLINING = consistent downward trend.

blocks.title: 1. Recovery Trends (Multi-Source)
blocks.caption: This enhanced multi-source recovery graph overlays WHOOP Recovery (blue circles), Garmin Sleep Score (green triangles, distinct from Body Battery), and 8Sleep Fitness Score (purple squares) with color-coded threshold zones: green (>60 - good recovery), yellow (30-60 - moderate), and red (<30 - critical stress). Orange markers (▼) at the bottom indicate "away from home" periods when 8Sleep data is unavailable. Gaps in the lines represent missing data rather than interpolated values, providing an accurate view of your recovery patterns across multiple tracking platforms.

blocks.title: 2. Strength Benchmark (Friday)
blocks.caption: This chart illustrates your typical strength output for this day of the week compared to other days over recent weeks. Observe any patterns or deviations from your usual volume to understand its role in your weekly training cycle and progression.

blocks.title: 3. Cardio Intensity (Distance vs Strain)
blocks.caption: This chart tracks running distance against WHOOP workout/activity strain (not whole-day strain), plus Garmin aerobic and anaerobic Training Effect on their native 0-5 scale.

blocks.title: 4. Weekly Load Progression
blocks.caption: This graph shows your total training load, combining lifting volume and running distance, aggregated week-over-week. It helps in assessing your long-term training progression and avoiding overtraining.

blocks.title: 5. Fueling vs Output
blocks.caption: This chart compares your daily caloric intake (consumed) with your estimated caloric expenditure (burned) over the past 14 days, offering insights into your energy balance for recovery and performance.

blocks.title: 6. Sleep Debt Trends
blocks.caption: This chart tracks your sleep debt over time using WHOOP, Garmin, and 8Sleep metrics, helping identify cumulative recovery deficits and sleep consistency patterns.
